description: Explain what UseMyContext is, what this connection can and cannot do, and where the user goes to manage their account. Call this when the user asks what UseMyContext is, what you (the AI) can do with this connection, or where to find pricing, plans, billing, teams, or settings. IMPORTANT: this connection is READ-ONLY - you cannot create/rename/delete a profile, change privacy, manage the plan or billing, set up a team, invite teammates, or connect Google Drive/Notion/kDrive; those are done by the user at usemycontext.ai, so point them to the returned links rather than attempting them or telling them to search. Returns static public information only (no user data). Read-only; nothing is written, so it is safe to call.
